note: MPI's pages (read 2026-10-30): the licensing fees page gives the driver's licence charge as $20 (beside a base driver premium of $55, which is insurance, and $12 for the licence card itself, neither held); it doesn't say how long the charge covers, so the term is null. The graduated licensing page sets the Class 5 stages at a learner stage of at least nine months and an intermediate one of at least 15 months, and the Class 5 page has a learner be at least 16, so a full-stage licence is kept from 18. The identification card page gives the Manitoba Identification Card at $20, good for up to five years.
